title: Define approved Mock-only DAILY read contract
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, ObserverOS API, database, credential, media, or deployment access
No business calculation, ranking, forecast, AI result, permission decision, or authoritative state
No personal, customer, appointment, media, financial-detail, raw-source, or raw-DailySurface fixture
No claim that a proposed contract is an existing ObserverOS API
No DAILY page or module implementation
acceptance: Contract defines PROPOSED/MOCK-ONLY daily-surface and trend-artifact envelopes
Contract allowlists anonymous operational aggregates and explicitly excludes sensitive/raw fields
LOADING, EMPTY, STALE, UNKNOWN, ERROR, and PERMISSION remain separately representable
No-data, denied, pending, error, stale, and unknown fixtures use data:null where required and do not collapse
Verification proves no network primitive and no forbidden fixture field
Contract records PASS_DAILY_CONTRACT_PROPOSAL and HOLD_LIVE_INTEGRATION boundary
